title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: using SFTP from AL (the native way)
summary: Business Central 2026 Wave 1 introduced a native SFTP Client codeunit for connecting to SFTP servers from AL code with multiple authentication methods, though Microsoft announced in April 2026 that this module would be removed due to platform hardening requirements.
key_points: SFTP Client codeunit in System Application uses SSH.NET library for both synchronous and asynchronous SFTP operations
Supported authentication methods include username/password, username/private key with or without passphrase
Server fingerprint (SHA256 hash of public key) must be verified before connecting to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks
Available methods include GetFileAsStream for downloads, ListFiles for directory listing, and DeleteFile for remote file deletion
Connection is stateful and must be explicitly closed with SFTPClient.Disconnect()

quotes.text: With Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 Wave 1 release (v28) Microsoft introduced a new SFTP Client module in System Application
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that this is a new native capability added in the 2026 Wave 1 release

quotes.text: You must always add the fingerprint of the server you want to connect to, before connecting.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical security requirement for establishing trusted SFTP connections
